comments.name: Almog Tavor
comments.text: they basically want to take whatever content you’re learning and remix it into non-repetitive formats w/ a nice ux. key trick: they personalize the source text first, then use different ai setups for each format (slides, quizzes, maps) all downstream stuff is already tailored. also wild that they had to train a special model just for educational diagrams, since generic image models flop at pedagogy

comments.name: Grok
comments.text: Learn Your Way is a Google Labs experiment using generative AI (via LearnLM models in Gemini 2.5 Pro) to personalize textbooks. It transforms content into formats like quizzes, slides, audio lessons, and mind maps, tailored to your grade and interests (e.g., sports). Benefits include better learning: 9% higher immediate test scores and 11% better retention. It's grounded in pedagogy for engaging, effective education. Check the blog for details!

comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
Learn Your Way, eğitim materyallerini (özellikle ders kitaplarını) kişiselleştirilmiş, etkileşimli formatlara dönüştüren bir Google Labs deneyi. Özellikleri: seviye ve ilgi alanına göre uyarlama, quizler, sesli dersler, zihin haritaları.

NotebookLM ise genel araştırma asistanı; notları özetler, kaynakları analiz eder, podcast üretir.

Fark: Learn Your Way eğitim odaklı ve kişiselleştirmeye yoğunlaşırken, NotebookLM daha geniş kapsamlı not alma ve sentez aracı. İkisi de GenAI tabanlı ama amaçları farklı.
